capabilities: Chat with notes and answer knowledge questions with source citations
Organize knowledge into domain trees and run checkups with repair previews
Store, correct, pin, and restore long-term memory and a user profile
Keep journals, manage to-dos, and track income, expenses, and budgets
Delegate projects to role-based employee agents and approve proposals
extras: Freemium: several features require an active PRO subscription, which does not include model credits. Mobile support is in beta and the author states this version's changes have not been verified on physical iPhone or iPad devices, and Windows/Linux validation is incomplete. The plugin file exceeds Obsidian Sync Standard's 5 MB per-file limit, so it must be installed per device. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README includes detailed privacy documentation covering local storage and all external services.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, so chatting with notes, maintaining knowledge over sources, and remembering user context normally require separate tools and manual setup.
